citation.authors: Taleb M, Brahim AT, Yebouk C, Khairy T

cited_by.title: G6PD deficiency: who carries it and what to avoid

record.population: Studies of G6PD deficiency prevalence in the ten African countries most affected by malaria, 2000 to 2023
record.finding: Prevalence ranged from under 1% to 23.9%, more in men than in women. Antimalarials such as primaquine can cause severe haemolytic anaemia in G6PD-deficient people; the authors say prescribing should consider G6PD status and that several regions need to review diagnostic and screening protocols.
record.note: Individual studies differ in test method and setting; the abstract does not name the ten countries or rate the certainty of the evidence.
